mission.description: The drone leaves its base at (-22572, 14826) and has to end up at (-4046, 19073). On the way it must stop at A (Police Pistol Range Heliport) at (-21922, 7717), B (Hall of Justice Heliport) at (-13646, 13888), C (Stanford Health Care West Heliport) at (6378, -23951), D (Washington Hospital Parking Structure Heliport) at (23934, -10288); visit A before B; visit B before C; visit C before D. Keep it no lower than 40 m and no higher than 80 m. The restricted areas and obstacles (Z1 [Oakland San Francisco Bay Airport (KOAK, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z2 [San Francisco International Airport (KSFO, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z3 [San Carlos Airport (KSQL, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m], Z4 [Palo Alto Airport (KPAO, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m]) are off limits, and that includes cutting across a corner of one on the way between two stops. The whole trip may not be longer than 137900 meters. The battery only allows 144352 energy units, where energy = route length + 30 x total climb (so low altitudes save battery). (START is San Francisco VA Medical Center Heliport; DEST is Childrens Hospital Oakland Alternate Heliport.) Coordinates are meters east/north of the region center.
